# pve_node_stopall (Action)

Stop all guests on a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_node_stopall" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_node_stopall.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `force_stop` (Boolean) Force a hard-stop after the timeout. (default: 1)
- `max_workers` (Number) Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. If  not set, uses 'max_workers' from datacenter.cfg, and if that's not set, the available CPU threads, clamped to a maximum of 8, are used.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout for each guest shutdown task. Depending on `force-stop`, the shutdown gets then simply aborted or a hard-stop is forced. (default: 180)
- `vms` (String) Only consider Guests with these IDs.
